name: Pixar-soft storybook 3D
description: Soft, filmic storybook 3D: continuous wrap shading, no outlines, a warm key against cool shade, shallow focus, big expressive eyes and brows that carry the acting. A better variant than a generic 3D cartoon: a colour script is planned per act (warm home, cool doubt, golden resolve), a complementary wall colour (teal behind a warm key) keeps rooms from going orange, and shade keeps a warm bleed on skin.
rules: Colour script per act: warm tungsten interior for belonging, cool blue for doubt, low golden sun for resolve.
Complementary set colours: teal or blue walls against the warm key; no monochrome room.
Continuous wrap shading (ramp smooth), no outline, soft shadows, a cool rim, warm bounce; exposure 0.75-0.8.
Characters: head 1.16x, pear or barrel body, big eyes (1.28), heavy expressive brows (1.35), lashes; acting through brows and mouth shape first, hands second.
Shallow focus on the face (DOF 2.4-2.8 px); backgrounds soft but readable; a practical light in every framing.
Camera: wide lenses and low angles for hero beats, long lenses for intimate close-ups, slow motivated dollies; hold the silent beat.
Every set has three depth layers and hand-made props (jars, bread, cups); nothing empty.
camera_language: Establishing wide, medium two-shot or single with a foreground prop, close-up on the eyes; a slow dolly-in on a decision, a held frame on a reaction, a lateral slide to reveal. Holds of 3-8 s, a move only with a reason that can be said in one sentence.
typography: Subtitles in long-form; title cards in a soft serif.
audio_direction: orchestral or acoustic score with a motif, soft foley, silence before the emotional beat
pitfalls: Warm key on warm walls turns everything orange: put a complementary wall behind.
Outlines flatten the look: leave post outline and character ink off.
Too heavy depth of field hides props: keep 2.8 px at most.
